title: Fireflies transcript import
description: The JSON shape accepted by the upload and paste flows (T-26.6). Only `segments` is required; everything else is a convenience so an export can carry its own title and attendee list.

title.description: Wins over the filename when present.

participants.description: Attendees. Anyone who SPEAKS is added as a participant regardless, so this is for people who were there and said nothing.

speaker.description: Defaults to "Speaker 1". Distinct names become distinct speakers, coloured in first-appearance order.

start.description: Seconds. Used when `start_ms` is absent — detected by the KEY, never guessed from the magnitude.
